input.quote: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: The non-solicit binds only us, runs for three years post-termination (beyond the 24-month walk-away limit) and covers every employee of Licensor and its Affiliates rather than personnel involved in the engagement. The general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out is already acceptable; we have narrowed the clause to a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved.

input.quote: the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period"). The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor. Upon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder, the Licensor may immediately terminate this Agreement
input.rationale: We are locked into a 36-month term with no convenience termination right, which is the walk-away case for a multi-year term, while Licensor may terminate immediately on any breach by us (no materiality or cure period) and also on change of control or wind-up. We have inserted a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund and no penalty; 60 days' notice would be an acceptable fallback.

input.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale: Renewal is a unilateral seven-year extension exercisable by Licensor alone, i.e. an automatic multi-year renewal with no opt-out for us — walk-away territory, and inconsistent with the mutual-extension mechanic in Article IV(II). We have replaced it with 12-month renewals by mutual written agreement and a capped uplift (lesser of CPI and 3%).
